items.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
items.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

items.title: Carney faces crucial test after walking away from Trump's deal
items.description: The Canadian prime minister will have to sell his gamble that walking away from talks with the White House will be worth the consequences.

items.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
items.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

items.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike
items.description: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

items.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
items.description: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

items.title: 'We're not going to run from it': Sydney Marathon laughs off medal error
items.description: Runners will receive a medal at the 2026 Sydney Marathon with an engraving of a German stadium.

items.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
items.description: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

items.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
items.description: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

items.title: Laptop catches fire on US flight, with passenger treated at airport
items.description: The pilot had reported a "cabin fire in the back" of American Airlines Flight 2398, which landed safely.

items.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
items.description: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

items.title: US military newspaper editor voices censorship fears after being fired
items.description: Erik Slavin believes he was fired for saying in an interview that "in a hypothetical situation, censorship would be a red line".

items.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
items.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.
